features.label_ko: 최근 도착 리뷰 주문 평균 별점
features.definition: 유효 상품 리뷰를 구매별로 평균한 후, 가장 최근 리뷰 도착 clock의 동률 구매들을 같은 비중으로 평균한다.
features.formula: For each purchase o, m_o(t0)=mean(valid arrived distinct-product stars for o); L=max(valid review arrival<t0); mean(m_o(t0) over distinct orders with review arrival at L)
features.window: t0 이전 전체 과거; 최신 도착 clock
features.denominator: 구매 안에서는 도착 상품 리뷰 수, 동률 clock에서는 해당 distinct 구매 수
features.null_rule: NULL without valid raw5 product stars or unsupported schema. Only raw5 valid product_star_scenario rows whose actual purchase/customer/product/order_line joins match; purchase already occurred and review.event_at<t0.

common_time_and_exposure.review_AUX2: Legacy rawreview row count/rating mean retained,including raw4 orderratings. NULL ift0<=signup or known observation_start>max(t0−30d,signup); fully captured short lifetimes may retain counts.
common_time_and_exposure.product_reviews: F37–F39 require raw5 valid product_star_scenario and actual same-customer purchase/product/line reference; earliest valid purchase/SKU dedup;strictprefix.
common_time_and_exposure.review_weighting: F37/F39 aggregate within purchase then equal purchase weight; no quantity/SKU-size outer weighting. Latest means review arrival; tiedlatest orders equalmean.
common_time_and_exposure.missingness: Supportedzero counts=0; denominator0/no reviewed purchase/no history=NULL. Raw4 does not acquire invented product stars.
